ari (Customer): Hey team — starting ~2026-02-14 15:20 UTC we saw a burst of 429s + increased latency from our integration. Users hit timeouts and then our worker pool retried which amplified the spike. Two example request ids we captured: req_20260214_1a2b3c, req_20260214_4d5e6f. Can you help triage?

jamie (Support): Sorry you're seeing this — we can help. Please paste the full response headers for those request IDs and a minimal curl repro we can run. Also a HAR or debug bundle (network logs + client headers) would speed this up. Quick curl example below — replace KEY and payload.

jamie (Support): ```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

jamie (Support): Also include your client x-request-id (or request-id) header and approximate local timestamps for each failed attempt.

ari (Customer): Pasted headers for req_20260214_1a2b3c: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 60
x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-rw-ratelimit-reset: 1768451250
Retry-After: 30
x-request-id: req_20260214_1a2b3c
latency-ms: 512

ari (Customer): Our telemetry shows ~200 req/s for ~120s starting at 15:20 UTC, most of it retries from our worker pool after the first failures.

olivia (SRE): Thanks. Can you run this to upload a debug bundle from your side (includes HAR + client headers + timestamps). It helps us correlate client and server timelines.

olivia (SRE): ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/debug-bundles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request_ids":["req_20260214_1a2b3c","req_20260214_4d5e6f"],"note":"429 spike 15:20 UTC","include_har":true}'
```

olivia (SRE): If that endpoint is blocked from your environment, please upload the HAR file from devtools or run tcpdump locally: `sudo tcpdump -w capture.pcap -i any port 443` and attach.

mike (Eng): Quick question for the customer: what's your client retry policy? Exponential backoff + jitter? Immediate retries can amplify throttles. From our side, I'm going to pull ingress logs for that 15:15-15:25 window once we have the request IDs and account.

ari (Customer): We accidentally disabled jitter in a recent deploy — so the pool retried aggressively for the first 60s. Sending HAR + curl outputs now (attachment). Here's a short `curl -v` snippet we ran (sanitized):

ari (Customer): ```
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
> Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
> Content-Type: application/json
> 
< HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\
< Retry-After: 30
< x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 60
< x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0
< x-request-id: req_20260214_4d5e6f

ari (Customer): curl timed out at 15:21:12.
```

jamie (Support): Got the HAR and curl output — thanks. (reaction :eyes:) Olivia, can you collate server-side timeline and check whether this was a quota throttle or an internal fair-use throttle? Also verify whether any fallback models were hit during that window.

olivia (SRE): Opening internal ticket SRE-2026-331 and collecting logs for 2026-02-14 15:15:00 -> 15:25:00 UTC. Please DM account id and plan (rate limits differ by plan) — I'll attach to the ticket.

ari (Customer): Account id sent via DM: acme-123, plan: professional.

mike (Eng): From a quick look at ingress counters we see a spike of 190-210 rps for that tenant, and our rate-limiter reported bursts exhausted (x-rw-ratelimit-remaining = 0). We'll double-check if retry loops triggered any downstream cascading rate-limits.

jamie (Support): Next steps:
- Olivia will produce timeline + attach ingress logs + any relevant fallback events.
- Eng will check whether the tenant hit a global or per-route quota and whether the token was reused across many workers.
- Customer to confirm they've re-enabled jitter (mitigated on their side).

jamie (Support): We'll follow up in this thread with the timeline and recommended mitigations. Thanks for the fast reproducer and HAR.

support-bot: Incident note created: support/SRE ticket SRE-2026-331 linked to thread 1768451234.

olivia (SRE): Timeline task queued, will post logs + corr IDs in ~30-60m. (reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:)

jamie (Support): If you need an immediate mitigation, temporarily reduce client concurrency and add exponential backoff + jitter. We'll confirm server-side fixes if any are required.

ari (Customer): Thanks — we've patched jitter and throttled concurrency to 30 conns as a stopgap. Will wait for your timeline.

jamie (Support): Acknowledged. Closing loop once SRE posts the findings.
